name: Facet
text: Make the timeline strip a horizontal bar at the top, fixed height, always visible. It shows the entire project duration in one glance, letting users see where they are and what’s coming next without scrolling or hunting. The trade-off is less vertical space for other panels, but the clarity and speed of orientation outweigh that loss.

name: Pane
text: Fixed-height strips bury critical detail when users zoom into dense data—users lose context fast. A collapsible, resizable strip with a "focus mode" toggle keeps visibility without locking away depth; test it with real users scrolling through Manus’s dark-themed graphs to see if clarity or speed breaks.
